잠언 6:1.content: My son, if thou be surety for thy friend, if thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,

잠언 6:2.content: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.

잠언 6:3.content: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure thy friend.

잠언 6:4.content: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids.

잠언 6:5.content: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.

잠언 6:6.content: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:

잠언 6:7.content: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,

잠언 6:8.content: Provideth her meat in the summer, and gathereth her food in the harvest.

잠언 6:9.content: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?

잠언 6:10.content: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:

잠언 6:11.content: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.

잠언 6:12.content: A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.

잠언 6:13.content: He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;

잠언 6:14.content: Frowardness is in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he soweth discord.

잠언 6:15.content: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.

잠언 6:16.content: These six things doth the Lord hate: yea, seven are an abomination unto him:

잠언 6:17.content: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,

잠언 6:18.content: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in running to mischief,

잠언 6:19.content: A false witness that speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.

잠언 6:20.content: My son, keep thy father’s commandment, and forsake not the law of thy mother:

잠언 6:21.content: Bind them continually upon thine heart, and tie them about thy neck.

잠언 6:22.content: When thou goest, it shall lead thee; when thou sleepest, it shall keep thee; and when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.

잠언 6:23.content: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life:

잠언 6:24.content: To keep thee from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.

잠언 6:25.content: Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take thee with her eyelids.

잠언 6:26.content: For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life.

잠언 6:27.content: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?

잠언 6:28.content: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?

잠언 6:29.content: So he that goeth in to his neighbour’s wife; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.

잠언 6:30.content: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;

잠언 6:31.content: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.

잠언 6:32.content: But whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: he that doeth it destroyeth his own soul.

잠언 6:33.content: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.

잠언 6:34.content: For jealousy is the rage of a man: therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.

잠언 6:35.content: He will not regard any ransom; neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.
